segments.ja423:1.1: Yo indriyānaṃ kāmena, vasaṃ nārada gacchati;
segments.ja423:1.3: So pariccajjubho loke, jīvantova visussati [jīvantopivisussati (syā.), jīvanto vāpi sussati (ka.)].
segments.ja423:2.3: Sosi [sopi (syā. pī. ka.)] patto sukhā [sukha (syā.), sukhaṃ (ka.)] dukkhaṃ, pāṭikaṅkha varaṃ sukhaṃ.
segments.ja423:3.3: Sa kicchantaṃ sukhaṃ dhīro, yogaṃ samadhigacchati.
segments.ja423:4.1: Na heva kāmāna kāmā, nānatthā nātthakāraṇā;
segments.ja423:5.1: Dakkhaṃ gahapatī [gahapataṃ (sī. syā. pī.), gahavataṃ (?)] sādhu, saṃvibhajjañca bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja423:6.1: Ettāvatetaṃ paṇḍiccaṃ, api so [asito (sī. syā. pī.)] davilo [devalo (sī. pī.)] bravi;
segments.ja423:6.3: Na yito kiñci pāpiyo, yo indriyānaṃ vasaṃ vaje.
segments.ja423:7.5: Ete ca yase hāpetvā, nibbatto sehi kammehi.
segments.ja423:9.3: So sukhaṃ nādhigacchāmi, ṭhito [cito (pī. sī. aṭṭha.)] bhāṇumatāmivāti.
